issues.on_page: Sales tax 20,026 (Operating receipts, proprietary funds Totals 2025)
issues.issue: This is sales tax the utilities collect from customers and pass on to the state (matching 'Sales tax' disbursement 19,825 on p7). It is not the village's own sales tax revenue, so counting it as sales tax inflates that category. charges for services/fees (pass-through) may fit better. Fund type business-type is correct.

Exhibit E (p4) prints this 11,356 as Special Revenue 'Policy/administration', which disbursements[0] puts under general government. Exhibit B (p2) calls it 'Community development'. So the function in detail differs from the basic statement. economic development is defensible for CDBG, but the two series disagree.
Probably license fees remitted to the school district. grants/payments to other entities would fit better than the last-resort miscellaneous category.
